description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing language strings, language codes, and language packs within the OrangeHRM system's internationalization module. It includes functionality for reading language strings from YAML files, managing database entries related to languages and translations, and creating or deleting test language packs.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling language translations, groups, and language packs, interfacing with the database and YAML files to facilitate internationalization support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a Doctrine database connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the stored database connection object.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a specified YAML file and group name, returning an array of LangString objects.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a language group by its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings from the database based on the unit ID, optionally filtered by a group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a translation value into the database for a specific language and language string ID.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language ID from the database by its language code.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Updates the enabled and added status flags for a language identified by its code.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack with language code 'zz_ZZ', filling translations with a pattern.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Deletes the test language pack with code 'zz_ZZ' from the database.
